summary: Add clear_done: remove every completed task in one edit, returning the ids, failing with nothing_to_clear, and undone in one step.
remaining: clear_done_removes_all_done_and_returns_ascending_ids: given a mix of open and done tasks, when clear_done runs, then only open tasks remain and removed lists done ids ascending
clear_done_without_done_fails_nothing_to_clear: given no done task, when clear_done runs, then error nothing_to_clear and state, revision unchanged
clear_done_undo_restores_in_one_step: given a cleared board, when undo runs once, then all tasks return in place with the prior next_id
clear_done_does_not_reuse_ids: given a cleared board, when add runs, then the new id is above every removed id
clear_done_is_strict_discoverable_and_replayable: unknown fields fail, the descriptor example runs, capture replays
